# LWrite

> A free browser-only rich text editor. Documents are stored on the current device, without accounts or cloud synchronization.

## Product

- [Editor](/): Formatting, tables, graphics, images, find and replace, local autosave, a document library and up to 20 versions per document.
- Imports: TXT, HTML, RTF, DOCX, ODT, OTT and FODT. RTF import extracts readable text.
- Exports: TXT, HTML, RTF, DOCX, ODT and PDF. Some formats cannot preserve every layout detail.
- Uploaded images and files are processed locally. Images inserted by URL contact their image host.
- Storage belongs to the browser and origin. Export backups before clearing browser data or moving devices/domains.
- The editor needs JavaScript. An already loaded editor works without a network connection; a fresh offline visit is not guaranteed.

## Public information

- [Privacy policy](/privacy)
- [Datenschutz](/datenschutz)
- [Terms of use](/terms)
- [Nutzungsbedingungen](/nutzung)
- [Source repository](https://github.com/ArturLauche/ldoc)

There is no public document API, server-side document database, or public index of a user's writing.
